failingStepResult.stepDescription: Wait for shell bar to load after login (purchase-order.fixtures.js:48)
failingStepResult.originalError: TimeoutError: page.waitForSelector: Timeout 20000ms exceeded waiting for [title='Open Search'] to be visible

triedLocators.note: Element was present and visible during re-execution. Original 20-second timeout was too aggressive.

failingStepResult.resolutionNote: Original locator is correct. The issue is the hardcoded 20000ms timeout in fixtures.js line 48. Shell bar lazy-loads 10-25 seconds after login redirect. The loc() method already has a 15000ms timeout which is more appropriate. Alternatively, increase the explicit wait to 30000ms or use a more robust wait strategy.

sapBehaviorNotes: PO was created successfully. After clicking Order, SAP returned to the PO list page with NO dedicated success notification (no alert, no toast, no message strip). The PO number is not displayed in any user-facing success message. This behavior matches the locators.js metadata (line 257: 'containsPONumber: false') and confirms TC-CS-021's intentional design: the test expects a dedicated success notification that SAP does not provide. This is NOT an automation bug - it's the designed assertion failure that validates defect logging workflow.

recommendationReason: The original test failure occurred in fixture setup (timeout waiting for shell bar), NOT at the designed failure point (success message assertion).
